# Example: inbound data, then outbound ACK
Fixture: `delivery_id=dlv-pr-42-1`, `peer_request_id=pr-42`.
1. Peer inbox delivers an authenticated `inbound_data` envelope with a lease. 2. Bridge validates scope and dedupe; local controller writes `/chd/objective/obj-local-42` and `/chd/ticket/ticket-42` with `fsync`, then reads them back. 3. Bridge sends `outbound_ack` with the same delivery id, local record ref and `durability_mode=fsync`. 4. Re-delivery returns the same ACK and creates no second objective/ticket.
Expected evidence: envelope, lease claim, local keys/revisions, ACK and dedupe record.
